statusRationale.coreImplementation: V2 compilation, verified admission, canonical byte coverage, typed snapshot successor, attachment, delivery preparation and provider evidence observation are implemented.
statusRationale.productComposition: Prompt registry, hepta-intelligence, Agentd and the provider-policy extension consume context compiler outputs, but the strict provider-bound V2 preparation is not yet the only serving path.
statusRationale.v2ProviderClosure: The provider host ABI exposes request digests but no qualified exact tokenizer over the final provider request bytes; strict attestation therefore fails closed until the host capability is supplied.
statusRationale.currentHeadQualification: No immutable qualification receipt for the exact branch head may be claimed before the qualification workflow completes.

byteIdentities.name: canonical context bundle
byteIdentities.material: Selected realized context items plus canonical envelope and item headers.
byteIdentities.securityMeaning: Every byte is covered; selected item bytes are exact and framing is compiler-owned.

byteIdentities.name: prompt fragments
byteIdentities.material: Developer-policy fragments projected from the canonical context for host composition.
byteIdentities.securityMeaning: Binds the product projection, but is not itself the complete provider request.

byteIdentities.name: provider final request
byteIdentities.material: Exact bytes submitted after all provider/model framing and request construction.
byteIdentities.securityMeaning: Exact-tokenizer input; must contain one canonical context segment and only approved typed framing.

byteIdentities.name: provider wire semantic digest
byteIdentities.material: Secret-free canonical semantics of the physical provider send, excluding credentials and timing.
byteIdentities.securityMeaning: Binds transport semantics; it is not interchangeable with the final-request byte digest.

sequence: canonical context serialization + complete segment coverage
provider host constructs exact final request
exact tokenizer over final request bytes
provider submit using the attested request
knownOpenItems: Supply a qualified host tokenizer implementation for each provider/model profile.
Bind the host-generated final request coverage and tokenization attestation into the live provider-policy ABI.
Make ContextDeliveryPreparationV2 and ContextDeliveryReceiptV2 the sole Agentd serving and durable terminal path.
Produce an immutable successful qualification receipt for the exact branch head.
